title: HELIX Terminology: Academic Period Type
description: Standard types of academic periods. Used by the AcademicPeriod resource 'period_type' attribute.

codes.definition: A ~15-week academic term (typically Fall, Spring). Most common in US institutions.
A ~10-week academic term (typically Fall, Winter, Spring, Summer)
A ~13-week term dividing the year into three periods
A sub-term or accelerated term within a semester or quarter
A short-duration term (e.g., May term, Winterim, 8-week session)
A full academic year container (e.g., '2026-2027'). Used for annual financial aid and reporting.
A period type not covered by the standard codes. Document in extensions.
